Thank you! ah sorry! i just saw the `ethereum/EIPs` in the link and thought it was to what has already been merged left a few comments:)! thanks! Should the EIP set a sane limit on the number of tuples in the auth list or will that be mempool dependent? Also what about either repeats (either verbatim or pointing to different code for the same account?) I'm not sure if I have good enough understanding of the implications of a large auth list to limit it yet. My initial impression is that it should only be limited by block gas and p2p wire size. Repeats are a bit unclear, i can update so that it is noted explicitly
